chunks.title: Citigroup (Citi Sustainable Finance & Transition) (Citigroup) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Citigroup (Citi Sustainable Finance & Transition) is a Global Commercial Bank headquartered in United States. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Major global bank with accredited delegation at COP31 Antalya active in emerging-market transition & blended finance. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: $1T sustainable finance goal (2021–2030) spanning renewable project finance, green bonds, water/adaptation & emerging-market blended debt. Source verification: https://countercurrents.org/2026/11/climate-summit-to-save-the-planet-yet-polluters-crowd-the-halls-103-polluting-entities-at-cop31-2-2-trillion-in-fossil-fuel-financing/.

chunks.title: Citigroup Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Citigroup (Citi Sustainable Finance & Transition) provides the following climate financing instruments: Green Bond Underwriting, Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL), Emerging-Market Blended Debt, Green Trade Finance, Project Finance. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 15,000,000 to USD 500,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Project SPV, Financial Intermediary, Sovereign/Government.

chunks.title: Citigroup Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Citigroup (Citi Sustainable Finance & Transition): Renewable Energy, Industrial Decarbonization, Water & Climate Adaptation, Clean Transport, Electrification & Grid. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Emerging Markets, EMEA, Türkiye, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, North America. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Citigroup Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Citigroup's application form: Citi Environmental and Social Risk Management (ESRM) & Equator Principles; ICMA / LMA sustainable finance alignment & SPT definitions; Second-Party Opinion (for labeled debt issuances); Credit & FX risk mitigation structure. Explicit exclusion rules: New thermal coal power plants; Equator Principles non-compliance. Official application portal: https://www.citigroup.com/global/about-us/esg.

chunks.title: Citigroup Form Template: Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake
chunks.text: Citigroup (Citi Sustainable Finance & Transition) uses the 'Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake' workflow governed by LMA/APLMA Green Loan Principles (GLP), Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles (SLLP) & ICMA GBP. Typical review timeline is 3–8 weeks (Sustainable Finance Structuring -> Credit Committee -> Syndication/Close). Form sections required: 1. Borrower Overview, 2. Structuring, 3. Transition Credibility, 4. Risk & Underwriting, 5. Mandate Pitch.
